text:
Jordan Eberle is 36, the Kraken captain and one of the few players who has been in Seattle since the start, with 382 games for the franchise and 783 career points before this season. He's still doing the job they need most: eight of his 14 points have come on the power play.

His finishing is honest, six goals on 6.5 expected, right where our range expects. The concern is five on five, where Seattle takes only 43% of the expected goals with him on, nearly three points worse than without him. At his age that's the part to watch, not the shooting. All Three Zones tracking (Corey Sznajder's) finds nothing far from the typical forward in his tracked games, no clear strength or weakness. He has 22 blocked shots, which is a lot of sacrifice for a scoring winger. Our range projects 43 to 64 points. With young players like Berkly Catton arriving, Eberle's role may be shifting from top scorer to the man who steadies the room.
